lines: [Local] Resident: It is already closed. It is no use if we can’t. So you [older man] cannot get in Never mind that it is closed, we can just go there It is forbidden residents can’t go there for praying there is one bigger, a mosque that is better this is fine for us here you cannot, you didn’t fulfill the requirements This has been disegel/sealed it should have been done by the government madam,

excuse me, Sir but what about if later kebobrokan happens here, huh? Better if you want to pray you pray at the mosque Sir. I’m fasting sir Yeah, I am also fasting Since we are both fasting, let’s each just cool down. Let’s let the woman from the RW neighborhood government speak Excuse me sir, we won’t allow this

Are you the woman who represents the neighborhood government? I am the legal team from JAI. it’s like this ma’am, there is a lawsuit against the vice mayor now in process, today we only want to do our Friday prayers first. no, it actually has already been sealed to anticipate so that today there is no Friday prayer here. prayer [ibadah] is not a crime is it, we want to pray.

Yes true, very true, but if you want to [pray] sir, please go to the resident’s mosque. So, it is like this, there is a small mosque and there is our mosque, just go together. there is also ours that is not a mosque sir, so it cannot be used for prayer, so sir, help the residents, if you sir don’t respect our residents, yeah, sorry anything can happen, we are prepared sir.

Oh, yeah, it is you sir that must respect us. Oh, impossible sir, if you don’t respect us as residents here and prepared, sorry this place has already been sealed sir, this is a residence sir, not a place of worship, Friday prayer cannot be delayed ma’am. there is a mosque sir, please go ahead We want to pray in our own place ma’am That is not a place to pray, this is

This is different ma’am, because we don’t want to accept this, we are in process from the start yeah, we just ask you, not you asking us, it is already in process to see if it can be used for it, then go ahead, we represent the residents But, aren’t you the one ma’am who can decide?

Actually not me, but I represent all the residents residents do not have the right to forbid people from worship we are all human beings and neighbors (residents), so how about if a resident refuses We usually use that for prayer, that is usually sir, but this is not usual, it has already been demonstrated to us because the residents are not here, please process it first.

I secure the environment here yes, that is a different problem sir, we are not going to do something that hurts the people here the thing is residents here won’t allow it sir We just want to pray!! yes, sir you also have to understand sir, that there are in fact residents here that has asked that you do not worship here And you are not a resident here

We Ahmadiyah believers are the same in every area different, different, but in bukit duri it is not sir, in bukit duri it has been this way for a long time Yeah, maybe before sir, but with the current developments, they don’t agree. So, I want to ask what is your name ma’am? I am Ms. Ashari This is inviting a fight sir, you must understand also No, this is because you are not competent [authorized], the ones who have this authority are the provincial government

That is all we ask sir, so that it will be safe here, please sir, go to our mosque or to another place. Now if we worship sir will you loose something? What will you loose? no loss, there is a mosque it is also our place, our place of worship yeah, what is the difference? Yeah, the difference is that is our place of worship That is a house sir, that is a house, not a place of worship That is not a problem sir that is a house sir, yes it is a problem if a house is made into a place of worship

Ms. RW head respect us, Yes exactly sir, if you want to be respected follow the wishes of the residents If we worship there is not loss to anyone True sir, but because in this environment, the residents here refuse so if you want to sort it out first, please sort it out first we are arranging it, today we request, I request you ma’am to talk, I want to do my Friday prayers, after we pray we will go home.

it is not like that sir, sorry, now it is like this of the residents here there are not any Ahmadiyah followers and the residents here don’t want to have that activity here. You just respect that. Ma’am you have to also respect us, we are also in the midst of a legal process, this is a problem of administrative law only, those who entered it may not have done it correctly. Yes, so see what is true first sir.

no one here wants it mister, so you process it first, there is no one here who wants it, now mister, just respect the residents here, this mosque has already been sealed so respect that now. ADZAN Call to Prayer It is better to go mister, you are not a resident here, if you cannot respect us better that you just go, before mister,

if you want to be violent, if you cannot respect people who try to respect others, we will just have to fight, I am tired of talking. ….and we can’t attend Friday prayers, ok, let’s go chase them until they go, give them a way so that they can all go, you all go homethere. This should be the authority of the government, This is all the residents that want it, so it is already sealed

Sir as residents you have to accommodate the government, it should be that when this building was sealed, it should be that it is only the business of the government and ourselves. So that is why we now follow the government, because the residents here don’t accept the presences of ahmadiyah, because the reason the government sealed it is different

Resident: Just keep walking mister, walk back for what are you stopping, while you walk back up while you move keep backing up, Just be patient, we are reporters, we work, this is Friday prayer why are you bothering us, we are working, we are reporters. What has been done sir? We are trying by our team to the mayor and the headman (lurah), later maybe we will have to go to Governor Ahok (yeah that is it yeah) Since when has this been going on?

Our place of worship, this house, we have used for a long time since about the 1980s or 1990s, so we are going to process, we have a right to this, a right for a place or worship, actually based on the regulations of two ministries, the government must give us the chance to get a permit.

he bald guy has not disapparead, wait for him, we will see from close up, those guys go up to them so that they are scared, make them go home fast you are from Bukit Duri don’t be afraid, go you are crazy Open a path, open this is Ramadhan, You are stupid, be careful you, if you come back again, you be careful,

where is your brain it has already been sealed up that is how it is, you don’t respect the government, you don’t have a house? This is someone who wants to say goodbye Mr. Ustad Where are you from? Tambun Next time doing show up here again, yeah, for the good of all of us, where are you from?

Do you call your self a Muslim? One prophet? If that is the case, we pray there, don’t come here again, please yeah, this is Ramadhan, please respect the fasting month. this is Ramadhan, please respect the fasting month. Next time you are not invited to gather in Bukit Duri, do you agree? agree…..
we still can tolerate residents of bukit duri, god willing pak Yudi will get home safely, give him a path, give him a path, respect Ramadhan. Roll him up in a matt/Old monkey
